newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Centrostal-Gd plans public offer this year.
newsitem.headline: Polish Centrostal-Gd plans public offer this year.

text.p: Polish steel trader Centrostal Gdansk wants to sell a million shares in a public offering at four zlotys a share this year, the company's president said.
Zbigniew Canowiecki told Reuters that subscriptions could begin around November and December if the Polish Securities Committee approves the issue by October 16.
Canowiecki said the company wanted to use the cash to develop its warehouses outside Gdansk, but its chief goal was to put the firm on the main floor of the bourse.
"The issue is small for Polish conditions. We are mainly interested in gaining credibility for the firm by going public," Canowiecki said.
Last year, the Gdansk-based company in which Stalexport has an almost 50 percent stake had a net profit of 1.84 million zlotys on sales of 78.6 million.
